id: \rMaylene: Hi! Hope you're ready for a super hard challenge, cause I sure am.
en: \rMaylene: Hi! Hope you're ready for a super hard challenge, cause I sure am.
it: \rMaylene: Ciao! Spero che tu sia pronto per una sfida super difficile, perché io lo sono di sicuro.

id: \rSorry about not accepting challenges earlier. I was in a bit of a funk. I'm gonna do my best to make the wait worth it though.
en: \rSorry about not accepting challenges earlier. I was in a bit of a funk. I'm gonna do my best to make the wait worth it though.
it: \rScusa se prima non accettavo sfide. Ero un po' giù di morale. Però farò del mio meglio perché l'attesa ne valga la pena.
\rMaylene: Ti sei guadagnato la Medaglia Lastra.

id: \rTM47 contains Body Press. Its damage scales based on your Pokémon's defense stat.
en: \rTM47 contains Body Press. Its damage scales based on your Pokémon's defense stat.
it: \rLa MT47 contiene Pressacorpo. Il danno dipende dalla Difesa del tuo Pokémon.

id: \rMaylene: I'm going to keep getting stronger. Just watch me!
en: \rMaylene: I'm going to keep getting stronger. Just watch me!
it: \rMaylene: Continuerò a diventare più forte. Guardami bene!

id: \bMaylene uses Fighting type Pokémon. They are weak aganst the Flying, Psychic, and Fairy types.
en: \bMaylene uses Fighting type Pokémon. They are weak aganst the Flying, Psychic, and Fairy types.
it: \bMaylene usa Pokémon di tipo Lotta. Sono deboli contro i tipi Volante, Psico e Folletto.

id: \bThey are strong against Normal, Ice, Dark, Rock, and Steel. They are resistant to Bug, Dark, and Rock.
en: \bThey are strong against Normal, Ice, Dark, Rock, and Steel. They are resistant to Bug, Dark, and Rock.
it: \bSono superefficaci contro Normale, Ghiaccio, Buio, Roccia e Acciaio. Resistono a Coleottero, Buio e Roccia.
